answer.title: Automate Purchase Order Approval and Creation
answer.trigger: An email is received with a purchase order request.
steps: Read the incoming purchase order request email from the team member.
Extract the item details and estimated amount.
Route the request to Sarah for review and approval.
Create the purchase order in the accounts system once approved.
answer.ai_help: AI extracts the item description, reference number, and amount from the email text.
answer.human_approval: Sarah must approve the purchase order before it is created in the accounts system.
answer.risk_reason: A mistake could result in unauthorized purchases or incorrect spending recorded in the accounts.
